newsitem.title: LATVIA: RIETUMU BANK HOME BANKING EXPANDS.
newsitem.headline: RIETUMU BANK HOME BANKING EXPANDS.

text.p: Rietumu Bank, the fourth largest bank in Latvia in terms of assets, on Thursday said it had cut commission in its expanding home banking programme.
The bank said in a statement that the number of its home banking programme clients reached some 700 in 1996, which is an increase of 80 pecent.
Rietumu said the cut was part of its new tariff policy and was also due to the popularity of the service.
Home banking software allows clients to access their account from any place in the world via the on-line mode and receive forex rate and other information, the bank said.
It also said that the software price is reduced to 60 lats from 100 lats and the charge per minute is down to 0.075 santimes from 0.15 santimes.
